about.title: Sierra Madre Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Sierra Madre is a small city, but its streets still see their share of collisions. Recent public records show 14 injury crashes and 17 people hurt in a single year, with Tuesdays around midday standing out as a common time for reported crashes on corridors like Sierra Madre Boulevard and Michillinda Avenue. Whether you were rear-ended near a shopping strip or sideswiped merging onto E Sierra Madre Boulevard, the aftermath can be disorienting — medical appointments, missed work, and an insurance adjuster calling before you've even seen a doctor. We handle personal injury claims on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover. Local roads, local crash patterns, and California's specific deadlines all matter here, and having someone who understands your situation early on can make a real difference in how your claim unfolds.

whyChoose.title: Why Sierra Madre Residents Choose Us

items.title: California's Deadlines Move Fast
items.desc: You generally have two years to file a car accident claim in California, but that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government entity — like a city road crew — is involved. Acting early helps preserve your options.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces your compensation. We can help make sure fault isn't unfairly pinned on you before you've had a chance to explain what happened.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: Unlike some states, California doesn't cap compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in most car accident cases. That makes it worth having someone advocate for the full scope of what you've been through, not just medical bills.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. Our team can advise you on what to say and what to hold off on.

items.question: What if my accident happened at a Sierra Madre Boulevard or Michillinda Avenue intersection with no witnesses?
items.answer: Even without witnesses, evidence like traffic camera footage, vehicle damage, and timing of city crash reports can help reconstruct what happened. Acting quickly to preserve this evidence matters, since surveillance footage and skid marks can disappear fast. Our team can help identify what evidence is still available.

items.question: How much does it cost to work with your firm?
items.answer: Nothing upfront. We work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you receive a settlement or award. There's no obligation to move forward after speaking with us.
